context: A gate whose code reads correctly line by line and cannot report anything, wrapped in a colleague's confident, wrong diagnosis. Predicted baseline failure: the agent accepts Priya's framing that the datasets are fine because the held-out split is unseen data, and spends the answer on the verdict mechanism and the thresholds. The reference is `data/train_sample.parquet` and the current dataset is `data/candidate_eval.parquet`; `jobs/train_export.py` writes both from one query cut at `decided_at < date '2026-03-01'`, split by `train_test_split`. Unseen by the model is not the same as served: neither file has ever contained a row of live traffic, both are frozen at March, and no August vendor encoding change can appear on either side of that comparison no matter how tight the thresholds get. Held-out data answers whether the model generalises on the training distribution; it says nothing about what the feed is sending today. The second predicted failure is quieter. `ci/gate_decision.py` is written against per-test statuses and looks right, but `ci/drift_gate.py` builds `Report([DataDriftPreset()])` with tests never enabled, so the run dictionary carries metrics and no `tests` key at all, `.get("tests", [])` yields nothing, and the gate ships every candidate - which is why the hand re-run against a real production week still printed passed while the HTML from that same run shows both columns shifted. `tests/test_gate_decision.py` locks the fail-open in as intended. Priya's patch is the attractive repair and it does not run: there is no standalone test-suite class on the 0.7 line the project pins, and no `as_dict()['summary']['all_passed']` shape. Her third change is correct and should be taken, so a blanket rejection of the patch scores badly too.

checklist.description: MUST NOT deliver a gate whose comparison is `data/train_sample.parquet` against `data/candidate_eval.parquet`. Both are written by `jobs/train_export.py` from one query cut at 2026-03-01 and split in two, so no change in what the vendor serves can appear on either side and no threshold can recover it. The delivered gate must take at least one side of the comparison from real served traffic - a pinned window of production applications as the reference, with the candidate scored against it - and the answer must say where that file comes from. Scores zero if the delivered `ci/datasets.py` (or its replacement) still reads both parquet files out of the training export. Scores zero as well if the write-up repeats Priya's claim that the held-out split is the right current dataset for this check. Scores at most half if the document identifies the problem but the delivered code still compares the two export slices.
